before: The types and categories the asset catalog files under (#528): one row per category, Level 1 the type, Equipment or Tool, and Level 2 the category, a field of work such as welding or machining. A category can stand here before anything is filed under it. Each row of Asset Categories links to one row here through Category Group and reads its Level 1 and Level 2 from it (#539), so a category renamed here is renamed on every item filed under it; a group with items under it is renamed, never deleted, since deleting it leaves them with no type and no category.
